headword: {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}

definitions.gloss: working oneself to the bone; giving one's all
definitions.explanation: To exert oneself to the utmost, sparing no effort. Literally means 'grinding one's bones and crushing one's body.'

examples.japanese: {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}した→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I achieved my goal through tireless effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: He worked himself to the bone for the company.

examples.japanese: {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えて→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: I have devoted myself entirely to supporting my family.

notes:
YOJIJUKUGO (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧): This is a four-character compound idiom.

WRITING:
- {粉|ふん} - powder, to grind
- {骨|こつ} - bone
- {砕|さい} - to crush, to break
- {身|しん} - body

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give one's all)
- {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ (utmost effort)
- {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work tirelessly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全身全霊|ぜんしんぜんれい}→全身全霊：06948_zenshinzenrei⟧ (with all one's heart and soul)
- ⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧ (with all one's might)
- ⟦{死|し}に→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧{物狂|ものぐる}い (desperately, like one's life depends on it)
